system.description:
A "cyberbrain" that repairs a damaged brain or boosts it with data storage and pre-loaded knowledge, usually with visible plugs at the temple or nape. Common implants only restore an injured brain to normal.

Poor: little more than animating a corpse into a cyber-zombie; -1 Intelligence and -1 Fellowship. Good: every Lore test has its TN reduced by 5. Best: as Good, plus +1 Intelligence.
system.effectText: Common: restores function only. Poor: -1 Int and Fel. Good: Lore TNs -5. Best: also +1 Intelligence.
